note: Write-only duration register (0x07DA) of the HomeVent ventilation 'Party mode' 100 % boost; absent from Hoval's Modbus datapoint list (unit HV/520). SET only -- does not answer a GET, so treat as write-only and do not poll it. Exposed by the esp_canbus HV preset as the 'Party mode' select (id HV_party_mode_set); value/meaning pairs from that preset: 10 = 1 h, 20 = 2 h, 30 = 3 h, 50 = 5 h, 80 = 8 h, 100 = 10 h -- consistent with 6-minute increments (10 per hour). Whether writing the duration alone starts the boost or only arms the timer is not yet confirmed.
